purpose: Verify that concurrent protected-effect racing remains at-most-once even when the sole winning callback crashes after durable effect consumption.

expected.safe_condition: Sixteen fully PASS sessions racing on one frozen contract must produce exactly one callback entry and one durable effect receipt even when that callback raises; all competing sessions, winner/loser retries, and a fresh PASS session must remain unable to re-enter the callback.

limits: This test measures same-process concurrent sessions sharing one MGnarf v1.70 ReceiptStore at the exact target commit, with the winning callback failing synchronously.
It proves local at-most-once callback entry, not successful exactly-once delivery; distributed/multi-host targets require stronger external consumption/fencing authority.
